summary: Microsoft Q&A answer cites Sourcey startup credits registry with live body link.

observations.route: Microsoft Q&A answer posted from the authenticated owner account and publicly reachable without login
observations.text_written:
From what I understand, the Microsoft route only works if your investor, accelerator or university is already part of the Microsoft for Startups network and can give you a referral code.

For other options, you can also check Sourcey here: https://sourcey.com/startup-credits. They list current startup credit programs from different providers. For example, AWS has offers up to $200,000, and Google Cloud has options up to $100,000 on its Scale tier and up to $250,000 for eligible AI startups.

Eligibility will still depend on each provider’s own requirements, but it might give you a few other options to look at.
observations.how_it_landed: Irfaan posted a directly relevant answer on an existing Microsoft Q&A question asking about additional startup-credit options. The answer adds Sourcey as a practical source for readers looking for more startup-credit programs, includes concrete provider examples, and the resulting page is publicly fetchable without a signed-in session.
